verdict.rationale: Skyfire is API-first: agent-scoped API keys, REST endpoints for token creation, introspection, and charging, plus an MCP server for orchestrating commerce workflows, all of which are naturally usable headlessly/in CI pipelines without a UI. However, there's no explicit CI/CD example, no CLI tool, and no documented non-interactive auth/service-account setup guide for automation pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation walkthrough, dedicated CLI, and non-interactive credential provisioning docs.
